review_scope: Every prose paragraph, equation, table caption, and figure caption

sections.sentence_basis: Study identity, model order, sample sizes, reported differences, and evidence limits.
Motivation and comparison to prior calorimeter-surrogate practice; each field statement carries a primary citation. The final paragraph states the exact question and evidence boundary.
Feature semantics, target definition, channel/layer counts, graph construction, split counts, and development-bank role.

Every architectural, sampling, decoder, loss, optimizer, and checkpoint-selection statement is tied to an implementation blob, selected-configuration identity, training history, or source audit. Interpretive sentences only state direct consequences of the equations or declared nonclaims.
Definitions are explicit equations or direct metric semantics; the classifier-control interpretation follows from its condition-only feature set.
Every number is reproduced from the immutable aggregate report. Statements about what the aggregates cannot determine follow from fields that were not retained.
The central interpretation restates measured aggregate differences. Alternative explanations are labeled as untested; proposed studies are linked to the uncertainty or mechanism each would probe.

sections.section: Availability, acknowledgments, contributions, and AI disclosure
sections.sentence_basis: Repository contents were checked directly. Authorship, acknowledgment, and tool-use sentences are declarations by the author rather than scientific inferences.

style_checks.policy: Prefer named variables, operations, evidence, and limits over promotional or vague language.

visual_review: All nine pages inspected in iteration 45; only pages 6 and 8 changed in iteration 46, and both were reinspected. The diagram has a source-level label-containment check. The geometry figure and results table were fixed at their explanatory text after page review found misplaced top floats.
